transaction.preliminary_write_rule: after approval but before digest revalidation, apply may create or verify only the fixed coordination lock; stale approval exits without target, state-root, journal, or shim writes
transaction.preparing_cleanup_rule: a valid PREPARING journal authorizes clean-preparing for only journal.initial.json, journal.next.json, state.before.json, state.after.json, state.publish.json, and exact operation-derived before, after, and quarantine names under the private transaction; each present entry must be a current-user regular file or expected private directory, but a regular file may be partial, missing, or have an umask-reduced subset of mode 0600; cleanup removes only those bound names individually, then the valid PREPARING journal, then the empty transaction directory, and never reads, writes, or removes a target or state file
transaction.probe_cleanup_progress_rule: in approved clean-probe, process only in probe_artifacts order after every earlier entry is REMOVED: PLANNED plus absent is expected and persists REMOVED; PLANNED, PUBLISHED, or VERIFIED plus an exact present expected-kind, expected-hash, expected-mode artifact removes it, fsyncs the probe directory, then persists REMOVED; PUBLISHED or VERIFIED plus absent represents a completed unlink and persists the missed REMOVED transition; REMOVED requires absence; every later entry must remain exact, and any unknown, mismatched, or out-of-order entry preserves all residue and fails recovery
transaction.probe_directory: <state_root>/.probe-<transaction_nonce> created with mode 0700 after complete plan equality and removed only by exact nonce-bound name after every recognized child has been verified and individually removed
transaction.probe_receipt: exact canonical probe.json is exclusively created mode 0600 and fsynced before other probe artifacts; it binds schema, approved plan digest, transaction nonce, Codex-home identity, target-root identity, state-root identity, exact probe artifact names, hashes, modes, and progress; valid residue is recoverable only through an approved clean-probe recovery plan

probe_receipt_artifact_schema.expected_hash: 64-character lowercase SHA-256 string for a regular file, otherwise JSON null
probe_receipt_artifact_schema.kind: string regular-file or directory matching probe_artifact_kinds
probe_receipt_artifact_schema.name: one exact probe_artifacts string
probe_receipt_artifact_schema.relative_path: single contained basename exactly equal to name

transaction.probe_receipt_extra_fields: rejected at the receipt, root-identity, and artifact-entry object levels

probe_receipt_identity_schema.artifacts: array of exactly five entries in probe_artifacts order with no duplicates
probe_receipt_identity_schema.codex_home_identity: object with exactly state.root_identity_fields and state.root_identity_schema
probe_receipt_identity_schema.state_root_identity: object with exactly state.root_identity_fields and state.root_identity_schema
probe_receipt_identity_schema.target_root_identity: object with exactly state.root_identity_fields and state.root_identity_schema
probe_receipt_identity_schema.transaction_nonce: exact approved lowercase RFC 4122 UUID string

transaction.probe_receipt_update_primitive: write canonical successor bytes to exact probe.next.json with exclusive create and mode 0600, fsync, atomically replace only probe.json in the opened probe directory, and fsync that directory; recovery validates or preserves any probe.next.json exactly like journal.next.json
transaction.probe_retirement: clean-probe removes each exact receipt-listed artifact, fsyncs progress through atomic receipt replacement, removes the exact valid probe.json last, then removes the empty probe directory and fsyncs the state root; a crash after receipt removal leaves at most an approved clean-empty-probe directory
transaction.recognized_ephemeral_rule: cleanup accepts only exact journal-listed relative artifact names under the opened transaction directory, regular-file identity, and matching recorded hash; prior absence of a listed artifact is accepted only with an exact valid COMMITTED journal and exact durable after-state or exact valid ROLLED_BACK journal and exact durable before-state during canonical retirement; state.publish.json is the fixed same-inode exception bound to state.after.json for both commit and rollback retirement; PREPARING uses the narrower preparing_cleanup_rule; RECOVERY_REQUIRED retains every recovery artifact; exact valid COMMITTED or ROLLED_BACK journal.json is the other fixed-name exception during its corresponding retirement; unknown files or directories stop cleanup and preserve evidence
transaction.rollback_progress_crash_rule: rollback progress is a durable lower bound: NOT_STARTED accepts the exact current mutation observation or exact restored before observation, and TARGET_RESTORED requires the exact restored before observation while every listed operation artifact remains available; an exact restored observation one transition ahead may persist the missed successor, while any other observation preserves evidence and fails recovery
transaction.rollback_retirement: after ROLLED_BACK, execute rollback_retirement_order in canonical recorded order with every affected parent fsynced and never remove journal.json while any child entry remains; each artifact is either exact and removed durably or already absent under the same terminal journal, so a crash before journal removal resumes at the first remaining artifact, while a crash after journal removal leaves only the approved empty transaction directory
rollback_retirement_order: require journal state ROLLED_BACK, rollback state progress RESTORED, every operation TARGET_RESTORED, the exact durable before-state, and no unknown transaction entry
remove each remaining exact authenticated operation and state snapshot artifact plus state.publish.json in canonical recorded order, accepting prior absence only under this same terminal journal
remove every empty allowlisted transaction subdirectory while valid ROLLED_BACK journal.json remains
transaction.rollback_state_progress_crash_rule: PENDING accepts the exact artifact-bound current state observation or the exact restored before-state observation; when the before-state is already durable, recovery verifies it and persists the missed RESTORED successor; RESTORED requires the exact durable before-state; every other observation preserves all evidence and fails recovery
transaction.rollback_state_progress_rule: every prepared journal starts PENDING; after every operation is TARGET_RESTORED, restore the exact authenticated before-state or exact prior absence, fsync the state root, persist RESTORED, verify the complete before roster and state while preserving every recovery artifact, and only then persist journal state ROLLED_BACK
transaction.root_creation_rule: after lock and digest equality, create missing target and state path components directory-relative at mode 0700; an existing target root may retain its exact observed mode only when it is a current-user real directory with no group/world write or special permission bits, while state and recovery roots remain exact mode 0700; immediately open each component with no-follow directory flags, verify identity and ownership, fsync each parent, and require target and state roots to share one device; on Python/Linux without no-follow descriptor-relative chmod, permission repair of a just-created name occurs only under the held current-user protected parent before the immediate no-follow open, within the declared same-UID tampering exclusion
transaction.root_retention_rule: never remove the user agents directory; safely created empty state directories and the fixed lock may remain after an approved probe failure or crash and never imply installed state
transaction.state_primitive: atomically replace only manager-owned state.json under the held lock by renaming exact transaction-local state.publish.json across same-filesystem held directories, then fsync the state root; a crash before replace leaves the journal-bound publish link, while a crash after replace consumes that link and leaves the exact after state
transaction.state_publish_artifact: state.publish.json is a same-inode hard link to exact state.after.json inside the private transaction directory; it is created only after every target is VERIFIED and is consumed as the source of atomic state replacement
transaction.transaction_retirement: after COMMITTED, reverify exact durable state and targets, execute transaction_retirement_order with every affected parent fsynced, and never remove journal.json while any child entry remains; a crash before journal removal is recovered by finalize-bookkeeping, while a crash after journal removal leaves only the approved empty transaction directory
transaction_retirement_order: remove remaining exact journal-listed artifact files including state.publish.json when present
remove every empty allowlisted transaction subdirectory while valid COMMITTED journal.json remains
transaction.update_remove_primitive: same-filesystem detach to unique quarantine, verify approved hash, then publish or retain deletion

zero_write_invariants: doctor and status issue no mutating filesystem operation and do not change content, ownership, permissions, link identity, modification time, or change time; access time is excluded because read effects follow host mount policy
usage errors and cancelled approval do not write
blocked or indeterminate read-only doctor prevents approval and every install write
stale approved digest may create only the fixed persistent coordination lock and never creates target roots, state roots, journals, state, or shims

approved apply probe failure with successful cleanup leaves no probe, journal, state file, or target shim; cleanup uncertainty may leave only an authenticated private probe receipt and recognized probe artifacts for approved clean-probe recovery, plus the fixed lock and safely created roots
foreign, modified, unsafe, ambiguous, or incompatible target blocks before journal creation
repeated current install and repeated complete remove converge without writes
